kind: external-agent process and workflow orchestration service

runtime.execution: Go city controller/tick and separate accept/dispatch goroutines; runtime transports launch external agent processes (tmux traced).
runtime.service_boundary: Owns city configuration, session/work/graph/mail stores, runtime lifecycle and orchestration event stream; external agent harness owns provider requests and native coding tools.

summary: Gas City provides programmable durable workflow and process coordination around heterogeneous agents, with mail, nudges, session history adapters and reconciliation. Its reload/handoff controls are not Arconaut executable refit.

inspection.scope: Selected source excerpts trace exposed entry/loop/request/action/result/state boundaries and relevant capability mechanisms; listed tests are read as source only.
inspection.limits: No acquired code executed, dependencies installed or live providers invoked. Claims concern this pinned snapshot; untraced catalog tools and dependency internals are not inferred.

actions.name: gc start / CityRuntime.run
actions.output: managed named sessions and controller event loop
actions.authority: operator config owns runtime commands; child agent owns actual model/tool loop

actions.name: Provider.Stop / Interrupt
actions.lifecycle: Stop process-tree destruction; Interrupt terminal C-c
actions.authority: controller/operator access; C-c is not proven model quiescence

actions.name: gc nudge / RuntimeHandle.Nudge
actions.lifecycle: bounded queue claims/retries and target incarnation; delivery receipt not response
actions.authority: caller via CLI; external process receives terminal/ACP input

actions.name: gc mail send
actions.lifecycle: persist before notify; notification failure leaves mail
actions.authority: agent shell/operator access; routing resolves actual session

actions.name: gc mail inbox / read / peek / archive / reply
actions.input: recipient or message ID, reply sender/body
actions.lifecycle: mail persists independently of live recipient; archive retains body
actions.authority: configured mail provider/store; distinct routable session identity

actions.name: gc mail check --inject
actions.output: bounded reminder preview and full message IDs
actions.lifecycle: next hook boundary; some handoffs archived on injection
actions.authority: external agent hook integration; hook failure does not fail user prompt

actions.name: gc sling
actions.lifecycle: durable launch returns before workflow completion; controller poked
actions.authority: local configured store or authenticated remote city write request

actions.name: instantiateViaGraphApply
actions.lifecycle: atomicity delegated graph-store plan contract; validates result
actions.authority: configured graph backend; not arbitrary LLM code execution

actions.name: PUT/DELETE /v0/city/{cityName}/formulas/{name}
actions.lifecycle: configuration mutation affects future resolution; exact authorization middleware not traced
actions.authority: configured FormulaMutator; do not infer public unauthenticated writes

actions.name: gc reload [--async] [--soft]
actions.lifecycle: accepted separately; applies on controller tick, not agent turn boundary
actions.authority: controller runtime config; storage changes require restart

actions.name: gc runtime drain-ack [name]
actions.lifecycle: releases claims, stamps incarnation metadata, controller poke; cooperative worker completion
actions.authority: worker/operator promises work finished; no verified provider-request fence

actions.name: gc handoff [--auto] [--force]
actions.output: context mail ID and restart requested/killed/mail-only result
actions.lifecycle: self handoff can defer restart; remote kills then reconciler restart; auto merely packages context
actions.authority: force bypasses live-subagent guard; underlying agent supplies context/compaction

actions.name: SessionHandle.Transcript / TranscriptRecords / History / AgentTranscript
actions.input: session ID, raw/normalized request, cursor/tail compactions/subagent ID
actions.lifecycle: read-only source file projection; depends on provider transcript discovery
actions.authority: history adapter and retained external provider files

actions.name: gc events [--watch|--follow|--seq] / events rotate
actions.input: event filters, duration, timeout, sequence/city cursor
actions.lifecycle: replay then watch/follow; city-scoped seq, archive rotation
actions.authority: configured API/local fallback; recorded orchestration subset

filesystem.detail: Stages overlays and files into runtime work directories; coding-agent file actions belong to spawned harness.

processes.detail: Starts external sessions, stops process trees and exposes terminal attach/C-c; runtime availability is separate from model work completion.

code_actions.detail: Configured runtime commands and declarative formula graphs compose work; inspected path does not expose a model-authored program VM composing native tools.

persistent_kernel.detail: City controls external agent sessions, not an interactive language kernel; inspected worker surface delegates child computation.

standing_database.detail: Durable work/graph/message/session Beads stores are orchestration state accessible via operations; not a general shared model-query DB kernel.

workflow_programming.detail: Compiled formula graphs preserve dependencies, variables, routing and root IDs; sling persists links/wakes dispatch; mutator API edits formula catalog.

multi_model.detail: Provider-neutral external runtime interface permits heterogeneous agent processes; actual LLM selection/inference owned by external harness.

live_collaboration.detail: Concurrent agents exchange threaded durable mail plus optional nudge/hook injection; submission/queue/wake receipts distinguishable, not synchronous shared inference.

concurrent_work.detail: City manages many external sessions and durable graph routes; separate reload acceptance and dispatch lanes coexist with tick loop.

steering_interrupt.detail: Terminal C-c and nudge are best-effort. Default provider nudge falls through idle timeout to immediate send; managed wait-idle can queue and busy delivery acknowledgment need not prove model observation.

turn_redefinition.detail: Agent runtime commands, overlays, hooks and workflow formulas are configurable; model-provider turn logic remains in child harness, not programmable CityRuntime turns.

compaction.detail: Auto handoff packages mail at external PreCompact hook and history can select provider compaction tails; no inspected own context compactor or selectable summarization engine.

context_repair.detail: Raw transcript records include entries hidden by active-branch projection; handoff mail supplies continuity material. No traced model-governed restoration of a damaged child context.

original_audit.detail: Sequenced orchestration JSONL plus external provider-native transcripts are useful but not all I/O capture: best-effort Record can drop, ack is not fsynced, rotation/retention and malformed-line skipping matter.

audit_query.detail: Event API/CLI list/watch/follow filter by type/time/payload with per-city seq cursors; transcript normalized/raw/cursor views separate.

hot_change.detail: Reload applies on city reconciliation boundary; child work can continue. Storage mutation refused until restart; soft reload accepts hashes without changing running executable/config.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Handoff mails context and restarts external process, with optional subagent guard; drain-ack is cooperative metadata/claim release, not compiled harness swap with verified no active tools/provider calls.

remote_services.detail: Runtime-neutral sessions plus authenticated remote city sling/event consumers; City owns orchestration stores/reconciliation rather than being solely external-fabric consumer.

self_improvement.detail: Formula/runtime/config mutation is established; inspected paths do not establish governed model-controlled autoresearch or executable refit.

complaints.detail: Mail and work beads can carry bug reports, but inspected paths do not establish model rageshake capturing state and tracking external complaint DB.

authority.detail: Agents may invoke CLI via underlying shell authority. Remote sling uses request-bound write grant; local runtime commands and force handoff are powerful; no inherited child approval semantics inferred.

evaluation.detail: Inspected fake lifecycle uncertainty and honest-queue output assertions; real temporary-file recorder factory and roundtrip/sequence/watch contracts. These are unexecuted source tests, not model or live terminal validation.

time_order.detail: Durable per-log sequence and stable cursor filters, bounded queue TTL/claims/retries, separate acceptance/application and graph projection reconciliation. Cross-lane convergence order explicitly nondeterministic.

evidence.claim: Go city orchestration around external agent runtimes, Beads, formulas and configurable providers.
CLI process entry funnels dispatch through run.
Compatibility controller creates CityRuntime and invokes its run loop.
Reload acceptance is separate; actual work and event-triggered reconciliation run on city loop. Panic recovery logs and continues.
Start stages configured overlays/files and starts a named external runtime session.
Stop destroys process tree excluding the calling process; Interrupt submits terminal Ctrl-C, not provider cancellation acknowledgment.
Default nudge waits for idle best-effort then sends immediately even after timeout; files are staged; missing sessions can return nil.
Managed delivery distinguishes durable queued wake, busy Claude wait-idle downgrade, ACP connection ownership, and submission delivered-unobserved.
Queue delivery has TTL, claim/retry/attempt bounds and concrete session/continuation identity.
Worker message/interrupt/nudge operations use runtime provider; runtime-only transcript/history unavailable.
Inbox/read operate message beads; reading mutates read metadata while retaining body.
Archive closes rather than deletes message; live backing store read avoids stale cached tombstone.
Reply returns to original session route and creates ephemeral message bead with thread/reply identifiers.
Mail send stores first, records event, optionally nudges; duplicate suppresses notify and nudge failure does not undo successful send.
Hook mail check injects bounded priority-sorted reminders; failures still return zero; auto-handoff mail archived on injection.
Sling resolves authenticated remote write target or local config/store/agent, installs runner and graph/work routing dependencies, dispatches batch.
Instantiation applies compiled graph plan, validates IDs and returns root plus node mapping/count.
Plan preserves native dependency topology and executable root types; applies vars, routing, root-only and idempotency metadata.
Graph launch promotes workflow root, persists source/store links and wakes controller/control dispatch; returns WorkflowID before execution completes.
HTTP formula upsert/delete validate and invoke configured mutator; no per-turn programming inferred.
Reload exposes accepted/busy/failure/timeout and async/soft options; wait bounds are CLI/controller boundaries.
Reload failure retains old config; transactional candidate and superseded revision retry checks.
Storage handles are process-lifetime and changes refuse live reload, requiring city restart.
Soft reload stamps desired config/provision/launch hashes and cancels matched drains without rebuilding running process.
Drain acknowledgment metadata binds acknowledging pane incarnation; cross-session ack has weaker binding.
Exposed drain-ack asks worker to finish current work then permit controller stop.
Drain ack releases held claims first, stamps acknowledgment and pokes controller; poke failure only warns.
Handoff creates self-addressed context mail and restart request only for restartable sessions; auto PreCompact handoff mail does not restart.
Remote handoff guards live subagents unless forced, then persists mail and kills running restartable session for reconciliation restart.
Provider-native transcript discovery/read/raw records/subagent mapping and normalized cursor/tail compaction history; no invented canonical full audit.
Record swallows acknowledged-append errors to stderr. RecordAck explicitly not fsynced; AppendBatch reports failure and allocates contiguous sequences under locks.
JSONL log rotation and optional archive-age pruning bound retained event history.
Event filters expose type/actor/subject/time and stable seq cursors.
Reads archived and active events, skips malformed JSON lines; scanner failure returns partial data plus error.
Native events command exposes JSONL list/watch/follow, type/time/payload filters and city cursor resume with incompatible flags rejected.
Exposed event list uses API or stopped-city local fallback; remote and supervisor consumers supported.
Level-triggered graph facts are restated after failure; step emission marker only committed after acknowledgment, tolerating duplicates rather than permanent miss.
Runtime interface separates Start/Stop/Interrupt/ProcessAlive/Nudge/metadata/peek/list and external runtime ownership.
Worker handles start/resume configured external command, attach terminal and create deferred/started session.
Fake runtime and clock tests defer lifecycle and preserve metadata across unavailable observations/nonconsecutive absence.
Tests assert queue downgrade cause and explicit skipped-wake warning, not eventual model reception.
File recorder factory uses real temporary filesystem; fake provider separately receives conformance tests.
Conformance checks event roundtrip fields and nonzero increasing seq; inspected LatestSeq and watch assertions are source only.

tests.focus: Runtime unavailable vs absent lifecycle destructive-action guard
tests.oracle: Fake runtime/clock/store: unchanged status+metadata, no drain/wake across unavailable observations; not real provider probe.
Pure formatting distinguishes unsupported vs no-idle; missing session store produces wake warning while enqueue succeeds; does not assert eventual model observation.
Real temp-file recorder and separate fake wired to suite; inspected source only.
Roundtrip fields, seq monotonicity/LatestSeq and watch existing/new data; no executed crash durability proof, no full provider-wire coverage.

strengths: Durable graph and source work identities separate launch receipt from completion.
Provider uncertainty is explicitly distinct from absence; tests challenge destructive lifecycle behavior.
Mail persistence, notification and delivery observation are separate outcomes.
limits: Model request/native tool semantics remain external; provider adapters must not borrow guarantees from harnesses.
Best-effort event recording and non-fsynced acknowledgment do not establish complete original audit.
Hot config and cooperative drain are not universal affected-workflow barriers; soft reload blesses drift.
arconaut_questions: Which orchestration primitives belong in external fabric rather than Arconaut consumer?
How should Arconaut prove quiescence instead of trusting drain-ack/C-c?
Should durable mailbox receipt, runtime submission and model consumption have separate audit events?
